caption: The video captures a black steam-cleaner wand, marked by a small white button, held at a downward angle over a herringbone-patterned tile floor beside a white baseboard. A plume of steam billows from the nozzle tip and drifts across the tiles throughout the excerpt. The nozzle travels back and forth along a diagonal grout seam, sitting near the middle of the frame early on before climbing up toward the wall base. It then returns downward along the seam and climbs again toward the baseboard as the sequence continues. The wand tilts slightly, shifting the apparent position of its white button with each change of direction. The steam cloud continuously changes shape, expanding and diffusing around the nozzle while drifting toward the upper-left. The framing of the tiles and the white baseboard shifts subtly, consistent with a slight camera pan or tilt. The process remains ongoing, with no visible start or conclusion within the captured portion.
